## MutationObserverController

Lit controller that attaches a MutationObserver to an element

### Properties

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `host` | `LitElement` | 'this' from a Lit element |
| `options` | `Object` | MutationObserver.observe options. Default: {childList: true} |
| `callback` | `String\|Function` | Called on mutation: either the name of an element method, or a function Default: '_onChildListMutation' |

### Examples

```js
// For a basic childlist observer, instantiate this class in your element:
 mutationObserver = new MutationObserverController(this);

// or customize the options/callback:
 mutationObserver = new MutationObserverController(this, {childList: true, attributes: true}, 'aDifferentCallbackMethod');

// or pass a function:
 mutationObserver = new MutationObserverController(this, {childList: true}, (mutationsList) => this._update(mutationsList));

// or from another controller
mutationObserver = new MutationObserverController(host, {childList: true}, this._onChildListMutation.bind(this));
```

## NavItem

Typedef: `Object`

Used by the NavController to represent a navigation item, which may be a link, button, or title-only item, and may have sub items.

### Properties

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `String` | The item's text: from its link/button, its own text, or deprecated link-text attribute. |
| `href` | `String\|null` | The href as written in the markup, or null. |
| `target` | `String\|null` | The target attribute, or null. |
| `disabled` | `Boolean` | Whether the link/button has the disabled attribute. |
| `ariaLabel` | `String\|null` | The aria-label attribute of the element that supplied the title (the link/button, li, or deprecated list), or null. |
| `fields` | `Object` | Text of each child element marked with the field attribute, keyed by its value (e.g. description). |
| `subItems` | `NavItem[]` | Child items. |
| `navPosition` | `Number[]` | Index at each level of the tree, from the top. e.g. [0, 2] is the third sub item of the first item. |
| `ele` | `HTMLElement\|null` | The light DOM link/button that supplied the title, or null. |
| `click` | `Function` | For button items: passes a click through to the light DOM button, so its listeners run. Use as the shadow DOM button's click listener, e.g. @click=\${item.click}.<br><br>Does nothing for other items: links rely on their shadow DOM href, so listeners on a light DOM link don't run. |
| `render` | `Function` | Renders the item's own link/button (not its sub items) for the host's shadow DOM, e.g. \${item.render({classes: 'menu__link'})}.<br><br>Takes an opts object, where opts.classes is a class string or a classMap object, or just a class string, e.g. \${item.render('menu__link')}. |
| `matchesCoordinates` | `Function` | Takes a navPosition (e.g. [1, 0, 2]). Returns true if the item is at exactly that position. |
| `containsCoordinates` | `Function` | Takes a navPosition. Returns true if the item is at that position or is one of its ancestors, e.g. [1] and [1, 0] contain [1, 0, 2]. |
| `renderedEles` | `Object` | The item's elements in the host's shadow DOM, set when they render. Empty until then. |
| `renderedEles.item` (optional) | `HTMLElement` | The link, button, or span rendered by item.render. |
| `renderedEles.linkToSubmenu` (optional) | `HTMLElement` | Drill-down only: the toggle button that opens the item's submenu. |
| `renderedEles.submenu` (optional) | `HTMLElement` | Drill-down only: the item's submenu. |
| `focus` | `Function` | Focuses one of the item's renderedEles. Takes an opts object, where opts.key is the renderedEles key (default 'item'), or just the key, e.g. item.focus('linkToSubmenu'). |

## NavController

Lit controller that parses menu markup in the host's light DOM into navItems, for the host element to render in its shadow DOM.
See examples for supported light DOM markup formats.

### Properties

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `host` | `LitElement` | 'this' from a Lit element |
| `fieldAttribute` | `String` | Attribute that marks a field element. Default: 'data-nav' |
| `navItems` | `NavItem[]` | The parsed items |

### Events

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `cork-nav-items-update` | Fired when the navItems are parsed, e.g. on host connection or light DOM mutation. Not fired by copyNavItems. |

### Methods

#### constructor(host, opts)

| Param | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `host` | `LitElement` | 'this' from a Lit element |
| `opts` | `Object` | Options. |
| `opts.fieldAttribute` | `String` | Attribute that marks a field element. Default: 'data-nav' |
| `opts.hostFocusedCoordinatesProperty` | `String` | Property name for the host's focused nav item coordinates. Default: 'focusedNavItem' |
| `opts.closeSubmenusOnEscape` | `Boolean` | Drill-down: the Escape key closes the submenu that has focus (or all submenus, if none has focus). Default: false |
| `opts.setChildHeight` | `Boolean` | Drill-down: on narrow screens, sizes the expanded submenus to the deepest one, since submenus from level 3 down are absolutely positioned. Default: false |
| `opts.noParseHostProperty` | `String` | If set, the host's property of this name is checked before parsing the light DOM. If truthy, parsing is skipped. Default: undefined |

#### setNavDrillChildHeight()

Sets --nav-drill-child-height CSS variable for drill down navigation.
Needed to ensure that level 3+ submenus are properly sized on narrow screens.

#### parse()

Parses the host's light DOM into nav items.

**Returns:** `NavItem[]`

#### getNavItem(navPosition)

Returns the item at a position in the tree.

| Param | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `navPosition` | `Number[]` | Index at each level, e.g. [0, 2]. |

**Returns:** `NavItem\|undefined`

#### copyNavItems(navItems, opts)

Replaces navItems with copies of another controller's items, and requests a host update.

- The copies share no references with the originals, except ele, so clicks still pass through to the original light DOM buttons.
- Use with opts.noParseHostProperty, so the host's own light DOM doesn't overwrite the copies.

| Param | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `navItems` | `NavItem[]` | The items to copy, e.g. otherController.navItems. |
| `opts` | `Object` | Options. |
| `opts.sliceEnd` | `Number` | If set, only copies the first sliceEnd items. |
| `opts.copySubItems` | `Boolean` | Also copy the sub items, recursively. Otherwise the copies have none. Default: false |

**Returns:** `void`

#### renderDrillDown()

Render a styled drill-down menu.

**Returns:** `TemplateResult`

#### static get drillDownStyles

Styles for a drill-down navigation.

**Returns:** `Array` - Lit css results.

### Template functions

#### renderItem(item, opts)

Renders an item's own element for the host's shadow DOM: a button, anchor, or span.
Automatically wires up button clicks and relevant attributes, and records the element as item.renderedEles.item. Does not render sub items.
Called by item.render.

| Param | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `item` | `NavItem` | The item. |
| `opts` | `Object\|String` | Options. A string is treated as opts.classes. |
| `opts.classes` | `String\|Object` | Classes to apply: a space-separated string, or a classMap object. |
| `opts.typeClasses` | `Object` | Classes to apply by rendered element type, added to opts.classes. Keys: button, a, span. Each value is a string or classMap object, e.g. { button: 'nav-drill__button', span: 'nav-drill__nolink' } |
| `opts.suffixTemplate` | `TemplateResult` | An optional template to add directly after the item text |

**Returns:** `TemplateResult`

### Examples

**Instantiation**

```js
import { NavController } from '@ucd-lib/cork-theme/utils/controllers';

// in the host element's constructor
this.ctl = { nav: new NavController(this) };
// or with a different field attribute
this.ctl = { nav: new NavController(this, { fieldAttribute: 'data-cork-nav' }) };
```

**Rendering**

```html
<!-- in your element template: each item's own link/button -->
${this.ctl.nav.navItems.map(item => item.render({ classes: 'menu__link' }))}

<!-- or assign classes per item type -->
${this.ctl.nav.navItems.map(item => item.render({ typeClasses: { button: 'menu__button', a: 'menu__link', span: 'menu__nolink' } }))}

<!-- or the whole menu as a drill-down, with ...NavController.drillDownStyles in the element's styles -->
${this.ctl.nav.renderDrillDown()}
```

**Light DOM markup**

```html
<!-- flat: a series of a/button elements, each a title-only item -->
<my-nav>
  <a href="/hours">Hours</a>
  <button>Chat with a librarian</button>
</my-nav>

<!-- list: li items, nested for sub menus, with fields marked by fieldAttribute -->
<my-nav>
  <ul>
    <li>
      <a href="/services">Services</a>
      <span data-nav="description">Borrowing, printing, and research help</span>
      <ul>
        <li><a href="/services/borrow">Borrowing</a></li>
      </ul>
    </li>
    <li>
      Collections
      <ul>
        <li><a href="/collections/special">Special Collections</a></li>
      </ul>
    </li>
  </ul>
</my-nav>
```

## PageWidthController

Sets the page width, minus any scrollbar, as a CSS custom property (--page-width), and keeps it current as the window resizes.
The theme's --full-width property, used by layout classes such as l-full-width, is derived from it.

- With a Lit host, the controller starts and stops with the host's lifecycle.
- Without one, call init() to start it and destroy() to stop it.

The property is set in a style tag (id cork-theme-page-width), one per root. Controllers on the same root share the tag,
and destroy() on any started one removes it.

| Param | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `host` | `LitElement\|Object` | A Lit element to attach the controller to. Optional: pass opts as the first argument instead to use it standalone. |
| `opts` | `Object` | Options. |
| `opts.root` | `Document\|ShadowRoot` | Where to add the style tag. Default: document. |
| `opts.selector` | `String` | Selector the property is set on. Default: ':root', or ':host' if opts.root is a shadow root. |
| `opts.propertyName` | `String` | Name of the property. Default: '--page-width'. |
| `opts.shouldInit` | `Function` | With a host, called when the host connects. The controller only starts if it returns true. Default: always start. |

### Methods

#### init()

Sets the property and starts listening for window resizes. Does nothing if already started.

#### isInitialized()

Checks if the controller has been started.

**Returns:** `Boolean`

#### destroy()

Stops listening for window resizes, and removes the property's style tag. Does nothing if not started,
so it can't remove a tag set by another controller.

#### getPageWidthProperty()

Gets the property's current value, as computed on the root's element (the document element, or the shadow root's host).

**Returns:** `String` - e.g. '1200px', or '' if not set.

#### setPageWidthProperty()

Sets the property to the document element's current width, which excludes any scrollbar.

### Examples

**Standalone**

```js
import { PageWidthController } from '@ucd-lib/cork-theme/utils/controllers';

const pageWidth = new PageWidthController();
pageWidth.init();
```

**Lit host**

```js
// in a Lit element's constructor. Starts when the element connects, and stops when it disconnects.
this.ctl = { pageWidth: new PageWidthController(this) };

// or only start while a property is off
this.ctl = { pageWidth: new PageWidthController(this, { shouldInit: () => !this.noPageWidth }) };
```

**Shadow root**

```js
// sets the property on the shadow root's host instead of the document
new PageWidthController(this, { root: this.renderRoot });
```
